points.statement: Aims to turn agent memory from retrieval at inference time into skills stored in parameters and internalized from experience.
points.quote: transforms agent memory from inference-time retrieval into parameter-resident skills internalized through experience

points.statement: Combines a slow deliberative language model for open-ended reasoning with a fast parametric module that reflexively executes consolidated skills.
points.quote: pairs a slow deliberative LLM for open-ended reasoning with a fast parametric module for reflexive execution of consolidated skills

points.statement: The fast module uses a multimodal expert-mixture architecture with category-isolated adapters, enabling continual parameter-level learning without catastrophic forgetting.
points.quote: The fast module is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts LoRA architecture with per-category physically isolated adapters, enabling parameter-level continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.

points.statement: Failure–correction trajectory pairs are internalized using a combined imitation and contrastive training objective.
points.quote: failure–correction trajectory pairs are internalized through a joint behavioral-cloning and contrastive objective

points.statement: Uses a worthiness score to choose which experience to internalize and a scale-free self-triggered mechanism to decide when to internalize without hand-tuned thresholds.
points.quote: introduces a parameterization-worthiness score for deciding which experience should be internalized, and a scale-free self-triggered consolidation mechanism for deciding when to internalize without task-specific hand-tuned thresholds

points.statement: A slow deliberative language model explores, verifies, and generates corrected trajectories that are staged in episodic memory.
points.quote: A slow deliberative LLM explores, verifies, and produces corrected trajectories, which are staged in episodic memory.

points.statement: Parameters are updated through isolated expert-mixture adapters trained on successful and failure–correction pairs.
points.quote: how to update parameters through isolated MoE-LoRA adapters trained on success and failure–correction pairs

points.statement: The adapters take successful trajectories and failure–correction pairs as training input.
points.quote: trained on success and failure–correction pairs

points.statement: Durable memory is described as arising from a fast sparse episodic store encoding new experience and a slow distributed parametric store integrating stable structure over time.
points.quote: durable memory arises from two complementary systems: a fast, sparse episodic store that encodes new experience and a slow, distributed parametric store that integrates stable structure over time

points.statement: The stores are coupled through offline consolidation, where episodic traces are replayed and gradually written into distributed representations.
points.quote: These systems are coupled by offline consolidation, classically associated with sleep, in which episodic traces are replayed and gradually written into distributed representations

points.statement: Addresses how selected experience becomes part of parametric competence, since external memory supports recall but does not specify this transition.
points.quote: external memory supports recall, but it does not by itself specify how selected experience becomes part of the agent’s parametric competence

points.statement: The approach addresses consolidation by deciding which accumulated traces should become parametric competence and when.
points.quote: PEAM addresses the consolidation side for embodied agents by deciding which accumulated traces should become parametric competence, and when.
